## Scope

fastreg:

1.  Converts Danish register data from SAS files to the modern and
    efficient Parquet format.
2.  Reads register Parquet files into R as a DuckDB table.
3.  Provides a [targets](https://docs.ropensci.org/targets/) pipeline
    template to convert multiple registers in parallel.
4.  Provides functions to list available SAS or Parquet register files
    directly from R.

## Naming conventions

In the sections below, we outline the naming conventions of actions and
objects in the package. **Actions** are verbs that describe what a
function does, while **objects** are nouns that represent the parameters
that the functions operate on.

::: callout-tip
See the
[Reference](https://dp-next.github.io/fastreg/reference/index.html) for
a function overview.

<!-- TODO: Use relative path instead? -->
:::

### Actions

| Action | Description |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| `convert` | Convert a register SAS file (or multiple) to Parquet. |
| `get` | Get or extract metadata, e.g., the register name from a file path. |
| `list` | List files in a directory, e.g., SAS or Parquet files. |
| `read` | Read a Parquet register into R as a DuckDB table. |
| `save` | Save data to disk, e.g., as SAS files. |
| `simulate` | Simulate register data for testing and examples. |
| `split` | Split paths into groups based on the register name (used within the targets pipeline). |
| `use` | Use a template in the current project. |

: Actions used in fastreg.

### Objects

| Object | Description |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| `chunk_size` | Number of rows to read per chunk during conversion. |
| `data_list` | A named list of data frames. |
| `path` | A character vector of one or more paths. |
| `n` | Number of rows to simulate per year. |
| `open` | Whether to open the file for editing after creation. |
| `output_dir` | The directory to save the Parquet output to. |
| `register` | Name of the register to simulate. |
| `year` | Suffix(es) appended to the register name (e.g., `"2020"`, `"1999_1"`, or `""` for no suffix). |

: Objects used in fastreg.

## Expected flow

This section shows flow diagrams for the expected workflows of the
package:

1.  Converting a single register
2.  Converting registers in parallel
3.  Reading a register

### Converting SAS files from a single register

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-flow
%%| fig-cap: "Expected workflow for converting SAS files from a single register using `convert_to_parquet()`."
%%| fig-alt: "A flowchart showing the expected flow of converting register SAS files to Parquet files."

flowchart TD
    identify_paths("Identify register path(s)<br>with list_sas_files()")
    path[/"path<br>[Character vector]"/]
    output_dir[/"output_dir<br>[Character scalar]"/]
    convert_to_parquet("convert_to_parquet()")
    output[/"Parquet file(s)<br>written to output_dir"/]

    %% Edges
    identify_paths -.-> path --> convert_to_parquet
    output_dir --> convert_to_parquet
    convert_to_parquet --> output

    %% Style
    style identify_paths fill:#FFFFFF, color:#000000, stroke-dasharray: 5 5
```

### Using the targets pipeline to convert multiple registers in parallel

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-targets-flow
%%| fig-cap: "Expected workflow for converting multiple registers using the targets pipeline."
%%| fig-alt: "A flowchart showing the expected flow of converting register SAS files to Parquet files using the provided targets pipeline template."

flowchart TD
    copy_pipeline("use_targets_template()")
    edit["Edit _targets.R as needed"]
    run_pipeline("targets::tar_make()")
    output[/"Parquet file(s)<br>written to directory<br>specified in _targets.R"/]

    %% Edges
    copy_pipeline --> edit --> run_pipeline --> output

    %% Style
    style edit fill:#FFFFFF, color:#000000, stroke-dasharray: 5 5
```

### Reading a Parquet register

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-flow-use
%%| fig-cap: "Expected workflow for reading a Parquet register as a DuckDB table."
%%| fig-alt: "A flowchart showing the expected flow of reading a Parquet register created with the fastreg package."

flowchart TD
    path[/"path<br>[Character scalar]"/]
    read_register("read_register()")
    output[/"Output<br>[DuckDB table]"/]

    %% Edges
    path --> read_register --> output

```
